g.text: Six numbers the board will watch.
Baseline, ninety-day checkpoint and twelve-month target. One owner pernumber; no number without a review date.
A number withoutan owner is a wish.
One page, one owner, monthly. No re-baseliningbetween gates.
Targets reset only at a gate, with a written caseand a date.
Two consecutive misses trigger a board memo, not anew plan.
NO NUMBER MOVES WITHOUT A GATE DECISION / REVIEWED MONTHLY
ILLUSTRATIVE SCORECARD · BASELINES AND TARGETS ARE DEMONSTRATION DATA
